headline: Last session: Sensex and Nifty 50 recovered as banking and IT stocks supported market gains.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Wednesday, 25 November.

why: Banking and IT stocks supported market recovery during the last trading session.
Record FII buying helped Indian markets extend a four-week rally to nine-month highs.
Engineering exports jumped 36% in October on strong US shipments.
Global AI selloff concerns and Fed rate hike signals had weighed on market sentiment earlier.
whatHappening: Shriram Finance will enter the BSE Sensex index from December 21 as Trent exits.
Lodha Developers Chairman Mukund Chitale is stepping down, with Akhil Gupta replacing him.
Sensex and Nifty recovered during the midday session on November 20 following an early decline.
The Labour Ministry launched a job-matching portal and occupational shortage index.
summary: On the last trading day, Indian benchmark indices recovered backed by buying in banking and IT stocks. The broader market extended its four-week rally as Sensex and Nifty hit nine-month highs on strong FII inflows. Meanwhile, BSE announced a Sensex rejig where Shriram Finance will replace Trent starting December 21.
